text: APPROVE: the merged guard and the extracted `DisabledEntryKey` keep the original check order and short-circuiting, so behaviour is unchanged, and removing three nested `if`s from the loop drops `ScanLines` well below 15. The unchanged tail of the loop isn't in the diff, so I couldn't confirm it doesn't use `entry`, but `key` is still in scope after the null check and nothing else in the diff suggests a build break.
